Short bio.

Taehyoung Kim is a research engineer at Fraunhofer IVI working on robotic perception and aerial autonomy. His research spans video understanding, multimodal sensing, and semantic 3D mapping, with a focus on connecting research ideas to working robotic systems.

My journey.

  1. Mar 2024 - Present

    Associate Researcher

    Fraunhofer IVI

    Research on aerial autonomy, from data curation and multimodal perception to mapping and on-board deployment. I’m also exploring language-driven mission planning.

    SSP at CVPR 2025 ↗

    Research Internship

    M.Sc. Aerospace Engineering

    Technical University of Munich

    Thesis: “From Supervised to Reinforced: A One-Shot Deep Learning Approach to UAV Path Planning.” Grade: 1.3.

    Thesis: “Fault-Tolerant Quadrotor Controller Design Using Deep Reinforcement Learning.” Grade: 1.1.
